note: A register's coverage: its hull, and per table its spans, gaps and releases. Table a has releases 2017, 2018 and 2020, so its spans are [2017, 2019) and [2020, 2021) with the missing 2019 as a no_release gap; table b is one 2020 release. A register has no columns. Fails if the hull or a span is not half-open, the 2019 gap is lost or given another reason, a release is missing or out of period order, or `columns` stops being null.
